title: Restricted weight local work
statement: For a restricted-weight input and a finite set $S$, the local work is $N_{\mathrm{out}}\bigl(N_{\mathrm{in}}(|S|+2)+3\bigr)+1$, where $N_{\mathrm{out}}$ and $N_{\mathrm{in}}$ are the outer and inner query counts associated with the input.
